source_title: I Can T Find My Course In My Profile
snippet_primary: "Payment on the website through local methods (cash, bank transfer) processed by dLocal: proof of payment or receipt from the store where the deposit was made."
subject_exact: Domestika help center (article 360003052038, undated) states users who purchased via dLocal local payment methods (cash or bank transfer) must provide proof of payment or store deposit receipt when reporting a missing course
local_qualifiers: dLocal local payment methods (cash, bank transfer) require proof of payment for course access recovery
parser_notes: support.domestika.org article 360003052038 (undated). dLocal payment proof requirement: cash/bank transfer users must provide receipt when course not found in profile.
